title: One Prompt Does Not Fit All: Self-Meta-Evolve for Personalized Information Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2609.21626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for enterprise information extraction (IE), where the same document must be reorganized differently for each user. Existing prompt optimization methods, however, rely on a single prompt optimized against a global objective, which is misaligned with the inherent user heterogeneity of real workplaces. We formulate enterprise IE as per-user prompt adaptation under interaction feedback and propose Self-Meta-Evolve, a hierarchical framework that maintains a dedicated prompt for each user and continuously refines it through a dual-loop process: an inner loop that edits structured prompts based on persona-conditioned feedback, and an outer loop that evolves the meta-prompt itself by distilling successful editing patterns. To enable scalable training and evaluation, we release a persona-driven IE benchmark of 292 simulated enterprise users, paired with a reproducible persona-generation pipel

translated_title: 一个提示词无法适配所有人：面向个性化信息抽取的自元进化方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署用于企业信息抽取（IE）任务，在这类任务中，同一份文档需要针对每个用户进行不同的重组。然而，现有的提示词优化方法依赖于针对全局目标优化的单一提示词，这与真实工作场所中固有的用户异质性并不相符。我们将企业信息抽取形式化为交互反馈下的按用户提示词自适应问题，并提出Self-Meta-Evolve——一个分层框架，它为每个用户维护一个专属提示词，并通过双循环过程持续优化：内循环基于角色条件化反馈编辑结构化提示词，外循环则通过提炼成功的编辑模式来进化元提示词本身。为了实现可扩展的训练与评估，我们发布了一个包含292个模拟企业用户的角色驱动信息抽取基准，并配套一个可复现的角色生成流水线。
tldr: 提出Self-Meta-Evolve分层框架，为每个用户维护专属提示词，通过内循环基于角色反馈编辑提示词、外循环进化元提示词的双循环机制实现个性化信息抽取，并发布了包含292个模拟企业用户的角色驱动基准数据集。
en_tdlr: Proposes Self-Meta-Evolve, a hierarchical framework that maintains a dedicated prompt for each user and continuously refines it through a dual-loop process—editing prompts via persona-conditioned feedback in the inner loop and evolving the meta-prompt in the outer loop—along with a persona-driven IE benchmark of 292 simulated enterprise users.
